title: Hearty Molten Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring shredded beef and fried pastry, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Season the beef mixture with salt and black pepper to taste
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada
Fry the empanadas in the hot oil until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot
